summary.text: Chris Knapp is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 53, serving since December 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Knapp's career experience includes owning a business.
Knapp assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on December 1, 2020, succeeding Roy Edwards.

For 2025-2026, Knapp chairs the House Corporations, Elections and Political Subdivisions Committee and the Management Audit Committee and serves on the House Minerals, Business and Economic Development Committee.
